title.title: Title
title.description: Rendered as an h2. ~10 words or fewer.

_direction.title: Display direction
_direction.description: IMPORTANT: always author _items in ascending chronological order regardless of this setting - the view reverses the display order for 'descending', it does not change how you author the data.

_reveal.title: Reveal steps on click
_reveal.description: When true, each event's description is collapsed and revealed by clicking its title (an independent toggle per step). When false, all descriptions show at once.

dateLabel.title: Date label
dateLabel.description: Free text, not a parsed date, e.g. "1998", "March 2010", "1980s", "Present". ~4 words or fewer.

_highlight.title: Highlight this event
_highlight.description: Use sparingly - source guidance recommends at most 1-2 highlighted events per timeline.
